positions.title: Engineer
positions.description:
Leading a team of two developers that are building a travel finance app for Android using Kotlin.

Building Java Spring micro-services to power various functionality for the upcoming The Points Guy app.

Lead developer building and maintaining Go middleware used in three front-end applications.

Led a team of two developers that worked on a never released personal finance app for iOS using Swift.

Part of a team of three developers that built Wallaby personal finance application for iOS using Swift.

Contributed to the final push to release Wallaby personal finance application for Android using Java.

Developed CI/CD for our iOS applications using Travis and Fastlane.

Rebranded two legacy application to match creditcards.com design guidelines.
